title: Punjab 2025: rivers spread across the monsoon floodplain

description: This sequence shows terrain-corrected radar response across the event period. Moisture, vegetation and surface roughness also affect brightness. This is not a validated water classification or a national flood-area estimate. The processed area is the explicitly mapped local subregion.

description: Use the baseline comparison to inspect persistent river-corridor and mountain-surface patterns. Shadow, layover, snow and ice complicate mountain radar. These views do not independently confirm a collapse mechanism or delineate the full debris-flow footprint.
